display_name: The Vagrant of Space and Time
access_or_summon: Use Shattered Disk in the main world with the Vagrant absent. Starfarer dialogue 77 grants it after Eye of Cthulhu.
source_evidence: ShatteredDisk.CanUseItem and UseItem, StarsAbovePlayer dialogue 77 gate, StarsAboveDialogueSystem dialogue 77, AttackLibrary wall spawns.

access_or_summon: Ask the Astrologian for the Strange Potion to receive Malsaine Draught. Use it at night in the main world with Thespian absent.
prerequisites_or_config: NPC.downedBoss2 for gift. Astrologian move-in requires the Vagrant flag or one of the specified items in an active player's inventory.
source_evidence: Astrologian.CanTownNPCSpawn and OnChatButtonClicked, MalsaineDraught.CanUseItem and UseItem.
notes: The native entry has no item-acquisition or nighttime availability predicate.

access_or_summon: Use Twincrux Pendant in the main world with Castor absent. One item use requests both twins.
prerequisites_or_config: Completed Skeletron and Vagrant Starfarer dialogues for the pendant.
source_evidence: TwincruxPendant.CanUseItem and UseItem, StarsAbovePlayer dialogue 305 gate, StarsAboveDialogueSystem dialogue 305, CastorBoss and PolluxBoss defeat logic.
notes: Twins share the completion flag. Castor is a co-boss omitted from the native NPC argument and has no separate key.

access_or_summon: Use Unsullied Canvas in the main world with Penthesilea absent. Starfarer dialogue 302 grants the item.
prerequisites_or_config: Completed Vagrant dialogue and at least one of the Skeletron Prime, Twins or Destroyer dialogues.
source_evidence: UnsulliedCanvas.CanUseItem and UseItem, StarsAbovePlayer dialogue 302 gate, StarsAboveDialogueSystem dialogue 302.
notes: English book hint mentions the Twins specifically. The code also accepts the other two mech dialogues.

access_or_summon: Use Starfarer Essence in the main world with the Starfarer boss absent. Spatial Disk offers the essence after the unlock flags.
prerequisites_or_config: The gift checks Plantera, Penthesilea, Thespian, Dioskouroi and Vagrant clears. Checklist availability checks only Plantera and Penthesilea.
source_evidence: StarsAbovePlayer starfarerBossItemDialogue assignment, SpatialDisk.UseItem, StarfarerEssence.CanUseItem and UseItem, StarsAbove.PostSetupContent.
notes: One NPC represents the joint fight. TsukiyomiBoss.OnKill also sets downedStarfarers.

access_or_summon: Use Ancient Crown (AncientShard) in the main world with both phases absent. The first NPC spawns phase two and its wall helper.
prerequisites_or_config: Completed Golem and Vagrant Starfarer dialogues for the crown.
source_evidence: AncientShard.CanUseItem and UseItem, StarsAbovePlayer dialogue 301 gate, StarsAboveDialogueSystem dialogue 301, NalhaunBoss phase transition.
notes: Initial phase has no separate native key or NPC membership.

access_or_summon: Overstay a Lyra or Dreaming City anomaly voyage to enter Katabasis and receive Demonic Crux with a live anomaly timer and no boss or held Crux. Use the Crux in Katabasis to summon.
prerequisites_or_config: Voyage UI requires a chosen Starfarer, active cartography, ready portal or stellaglyph, tier 3, no voyage cooldown. MultiplayerFallbackSubworlds adds a direct MP branch.
source_evidence: CelestialCompass.TeleportLyra and TeleportDreamingCity, SubworldPlayer anomaly handling, DemonicCrux.UseItem, StarsAboveServersideConfig.OnChanged.
notes: Native entry has no spawnItems metadata. Outside Katabasis the ordinary Crux use enters the arena first.

access_or_summon: Use Progenitor Wish in the main world during active Everlasting Light or after the Warrior clear. The opening NPC spawns the final phase.
prerequisites_or_config: Starfarer dialogue 304 offers the item during preview or active event. Initial fight needs active event, not preview.
source_evidence: ProgenitorWish.CanUseItem and UseItem, StarsAbovePlayer dialogue 304 gate, StarsAboveDialogueSystem dialogue 304, WarriorOfLightBoss phase transition, AttackLibrary.WarriorGardenOfAvalon.
notes: Canonical suffix is the opening type name but the NPC argument is the final phase only.

access_or_summon: Craft Mnemonic Sigil at Celestriad Root with four distinct traces. In single-player the first use enters Eternal Confluence and use there requests the fight. MP client requests the NPC directly.
prerequisites_or_config: Traces are gifts from the Warrior, Nalhaun, Penthesilea and Dioskouroi clear dialogues. Item blocks use while the boss exists.
source_evidence: StarsAboveDialogueSystem dialogues 66 and 69–71, StarsAbovePlayer corresponding clear gates, MnemonicSigil.AddRecipes and UseItem, CelestialCompass root gift, EternalConfluence copied flag methods.
notes: The sole book availability gate is Warrior cleared. It does not test the other traces.

prerequisites_or_config: Fresh defaults 2 and 7 increments at 54000 updates each. Warrior clear disables both states. Saved timer and threshold behavior on reload needs testing.
source_evidence: EverlastingLightEvent.PostUpdateTime, SaveWorldData, LoadWorldData and PreUpdateInvasions, EverlastingLightPlayer, StarsAboveGlobalNPC.
registration_scope: No native standalone call or explicit event membership in StarsAbove.PostSetupContent
notes: One event with preview and active stages. No fixed registered NPC list. Relationship to Warrior is an access gate, not Checklist event membership.
